editions.title: Results from the weekend
editions.intro: Action has concluded in Formula 1 and MotoGP, while the NASCAR Cup Series prepares for its next round at Charlotte Motor Speedway.

items.headline: Singapore Grand Prix
items.detail: Marina Bay Street Circuit, Singapore · Sun 11 Oct
items.body: Max Verstappen won from pole for Red Bull, finishing 7.3 seconds ahead of Charles Leclerc in Ferrari. Andrea Kimi Antonelli finished third for Mercedes, extending his championship lead over George Russell to 102 points. The race saw several retirements including Alexander Albon and Lance Stroll.
facts: Max Verstappen won from pole, 7.3 seconds ahead of Charles Leclerc
Biggest climbers: Isack Hadjar from 22nd to 10th and George Russell from 19th to 9th
Fastest lap: Charles Leclerc, 1:35.202
Did not finish: Alexander Albon, Lance Stroll, Franco Colapinto and Gabriel Bortoleto
Andrea Kimi Antonelli's championship lead over George Russell went from 84 to 102 points over the weekend
Virtual safety car on laps 8 and 39

items.headline: Grand Prix of Indonesia
items.detail: Pertamina Mandalika Circuit, Indonesia · Sun 11 Oct
items.body: Marco Bezzecchi won for Aprilia Racing, finishing 4.3 seconds ahead of Raul Fernandez in the SuperFile Trackhouse MotoGP Team. Jorge Martin took third for Aprilia Racing to remain two points ahead of Marc Marquez in the championship. Bezzecchi also set a new lap record during the event.
facts: Marco Bezzecchi won by 4.3 seconds from Raul Fernandez
Did not finish: Toprak Razgatlioglu, Jack Miller, Francesco Bagnaia and Fermin Aldeguer
Marco Bezzecchi set a new lap record, 1:29.960
Dry, 29°C air and 62°C track
Saturday's sprint was won by Marc Marquez
Jorge Martin leads the championship by 2 points from Marc Marquez

items.headline: Bank of America 400
items.body: The Bank of America 400 runs on Sunday 11 Oct at Charlotte Motor Speedway. The event will cover 267 laps and 400.5 miles, starting at 19:00 UTC.
facts: 267 laps, 400.5 miles
US coverage: USA (TV), PRN (radio)

lastRaces.headline: London E-Prix
lastRaces.body: Taylor Barnard took victory for DS Penske at the London E-Prix. He finished ahead of Mahindra Racing's Nyck De Vries and Edoardo Mortara. Pascal Wehrlein maintained a five-point lead over Jake Dennis in the championship.
facts: Pascal Wehrlein leads the championship by 5 points from Jake Dennis
